title: Find why fresh worktrees found no affected map to borrow
findings_note: v1.15 relays 2026-10-18: implementers in fresh worktrees cut from main reported `affected.py` found no map to borrow and ran the full suite instead, although full suites had passed on main; cause not established
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the borrow rules (s367) without a reproduction that shows they are wrong.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `affected.py` borrows another worktree's clean map recorded at HEAD or an ancestor (AGENTS.md, Commands). In the v1.15 run fresh worktrees often found none, so the implementer's iteration loop cost a full suite under parallel load (25-40 min). Possible causes include main's map being recorded dirty (`"clean": false`), main's map being at a commit that is not an ancestor of the worktree's HEAD, or main having uncommitted changes under `src/` or `tests/` at the time; none is confirmed.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/affected.py` (borrow lookup and its stderr), `tests/test_affected.py`.
- `AGENTS.md` (Commands) if the rule or its wording changes; `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - A test that reproduces the miss, named after the cause once found.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reproduce: on main run the full discover on a clean tree, cut a worktree from main, run `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run` there, and record its stderr. Repeat after a merge commit and after a `done` commit on main.
2. If it borrows, close the item with a note recording the reproduction. If not, write the failing test for the cause, fix it, and update AGENTS.md if the rule changes.
3. CHANGELOG under Fixed if code changed; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
